extra/simple_agent_complete.txt.title: The reason/act/observe loop
note: **The heart of every agent: ask the model, parse its action, run the tool, feed back the result.**
- Unparseable replies get a retry request instead of a crash
- `final` ends the loop; otherwise the observation (plus a reminder of how to finish) becomes the next user message

note: **Commits that touched one file — after checking the path is safe.**

extra/git_mcp_complete.txt.title: Guarded git escape hatch
note: **Flexible git access with two hard rules enforced before running anything.**

extra/safe_agent_complete.txt.title: The guardrail gate
note: **Every tool call passes three checkpoints: policy validation, human approval, audited execution.**
- Denials return a DENIED observation — the agent survives and adapts
- Every decision (denied/approved/executed) lands in audit_log.jsonl

extra/run_evals_complete.txt.title: Deterministic eval checks
note: **Four fact-based checks — no LLM judging, just observable outcomes.**

- max_tool_calls enforces an efficiency budget per scenario
